- Build a complete, playable 3D car-life simulation game named “My Spring Car” based on the user’s Malay-language concept.

## Requirements
- Main menu with New Game, Continue, and Settings for graphics and controls.
- Home with bed, kitchen, washroom; player stats for health, hunger, thirst, stress, cleanliness, money, and fatigue.
- Explore using a motorcycle, find missing car parts, visit a workshop and grocery shop, maintain needs, and sleep to save.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone Three.js browser game in one `index.html`; UI and gameplay text are mostly English with some Malay wording.
- Save state uses browser `localStorage`; graphics toggle switches pixel ratio, and control sensitivity is represented in settings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a menu, 3D town/home scene, player movement, HUD, needs management, interactions, shops, vehicle driving, part collection/installing, and sleep/save behavior.
- Added responsive on-screen touch controls alongside keyboard controls.
